plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.37 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a very confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = at least 4.2 mag is extremely red, like the coldest brown dwarfs (late-T and Y).
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a T3 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (T5) fits clearly worse.
